mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60-day horizons.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns negative in > 60% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 1.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive in > 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate weakening economic activity, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive in > 50% of instances where both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 305), central banks maintain restrictive monetary policy, suppressing equity returns over 5-day horizons.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns positive in > 45% of high CPI periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) reflect strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20-day horizons.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns negative in > 55% of RSAFS growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1350 thousand units (HOUST < 1350) signal weak construction activity, reducing economic growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive in > 50% of HOUST < 1350 periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high CPI (CPIAUCSL > 305) and elevated FEDFUNDS (> 5.0%) indicate aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive in > 40% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 305 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness supports wage growth and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20-day horizons.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns negative in > 55% of UNRATE < 4.0% periods.
